# Code Anchors: Component Invocation Gate

- `libs/portable-tools/src/component-invocations.ts` — the scanner: the code-span reader with its fence-marker length tracking, the closed set of addressing forms and its leader tokens, the legacy list, and the classification against the declared surface read as a value.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/component-invocations.spec.ts` — code-span extraction, the narrowed form set, and the repository-bound rejections shown untouched by that narrowing.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the declared surface the gate resolves a named invocation against, obtained from the registry itself and never a copy.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-payload.ts` — defines the set of shipped bodies the gate reads, so no shipped body escapes it.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-gate.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/release-gate.spec.ts` — the narrower release-time path precondition this build-time check keeps green ahead of.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-master-reads.ts` — the sibling scan over the same shipped bodies, checking locations where this one checks invocations.
- `components/commands`, `components/skills` — the shipped bodies scanned, every invocation in them naming the executable and a dispatch name it declares.
- `docs/delivery/release-procedure.md` — the procedure step that runs this gate, and the remedy it names for a failure.
